correctness.rationale: For normalized monotone submodular f with positive singleton capacities, sorted greedy optimization gives h_{P_f}(v)=integral f({e:v_e>=t})dt for v>=0 and down-closedness gives h(v)=h(v_+). Euclidean triangle inequality applied to inverse-diagonal weighted layer-cake bounds support below by inverse R=max sqrt(c(S))/f(S); positive/negative sign decomposition yields width >=1/R in every unit direction. A signed normalized inverse-scaled indicator of a minimizing subset attains equality. Equality in triangle integral forces one nonempty level support, and sign-split equality forces one sign, proving the COMPLETE minimizing-direction set. Matroid maximizing support must be flat and connected; uniform U_r,n has min(1,r/sqrt(n)) with axis/all-ones transition at n=r^2. Independent greedy-support calculations and 200 random normals per selected uniform matroid including n=r^2 corroborate, but all-f proof is analytic.

value.rationale: The independence polytope of a matroid or polymatroid is canonical; its smallest ambient directional width and all narrowest directions are natural intrinsic geometric invariants. The formula transfers the Euclidean extremal problem to a sharp finite rank-density quotient, identifies a meaningful sharp n=r^2 phase transition for uniform matroids, and supplies equality rigidity.
